tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil chog srid gsum 'dul byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil chog srid gsum 'dul byed ces bya ba/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa kun bcom zhing*/ /zhi ba'i mtha' la'ang mi ltung bar/ /go 'phang mchog la 'god der 'dud/ /gang zhig 'gro rnams smin zhing grol ba'i slad/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas dkyil 'khor cho ga gsungs/ /blun po spyi brtol can gyis yul min te/ /sngags rig mkhas rnams mgu ba 'di la 'jug /rgyal ba'i bka' sde snod gsum dang*/ shing rta chen po'i gzhung rnams nges par bsten dgos pa'i chos yin yang*/ da lta'i mtshan nyid pa rnams kyi byed tshul ni/ tshig la 'chel zhing gzhung dang lag len rgyab 'gal du 'gyur pas rang gi yun ring sbyangs pa'i chos la ma mgu bar bdud rtsi'i zas spangs te/ mi gtsang ba'i zas la khyi rnams rtsod pa lta bur gyur pa dang*/ yang sgom chen par khas mche ba dag lta skad mtho mtho po 'ga' zhig gi tshig la zhen nas/ dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i thabs khyad par can rnams ris su 'bor ba ni/ tshad pa'i nad ma smin pa la ga bur gyi sman btang ba bzhin nyams nyes su gyur pa dang*/ yang kha cig spros pa byed pa rnams la rnyed bkur 'byung ba mthong nas/ brgyud pa med cing lag len nor ba'i cho ga brdzus ma rnams kyis blun po mgo skor ba dang*/ sgra dang rtog ge sogs la shes 'dod langs pas sgom chen pa'i rang tshugs zhig pa dag ni/ dper na/ rgyal srid kyi bya ba bor nas chang 'tshong ma'i khyim rtag tu bsten pa dang mtshungs so/ /de lta bas na mkhas 'dod dang grub par rdzu ba'i mtha' gnyis su ma lhung bar/ yang dag pa'i lam las 'bras bu mchod grub par 'dod na/ dus kyi tha ma 'di lta bur rdo rje theg pa la nges par brten dgos shing*/ de'i rtsa ba yang khungs dang*/ brgyud par ldan zhing*/ lag len ma nor ba'i dbang gi cho gas smin pa ci dgos so/

/zhes pa 'di thams cad du go bar bya'o/ / skabs 'dir dpal 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la/ dang por slob ma rjes bzung ngam lha dang bla ma la gsol ba gdab cing srung ba'i cho ga ni/ gzhung nyid la rgyas shing gsal bar yod pa ltar yin te/ de yang slob dpon gyi maṇ+ḍal bcas/ slob ma'i gsol ba 'debs pa dang dri ba dri lan bya/ maṇ+ḍal der tshom bu bkod/ lha spyan drangs nas rgyun bshags yan lag bcu pa phyed du 'jug /bsrung ba'i don du/ oṃ a mṛ ta hūṃ/ zhes pa bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags thung gi bzlas lung tsam sbyin pa yin te/ 'on kyang de dag phyis lag len mi mdzad par snang bas go yul tsam du byas pas chog go /gnyis pa bsnyen pa byed tshul yang spyi dang mtshungs shing*/ bum chog la brten nas bsnyen pa kha gso byed pa'i srol yang byung ngo/ / gsum pa sa chog ni/ brtag bslang sbyang bzung bsrung ba ste lnga'o/ /dang po brtag pa ni spyi dang 'dra/ gnyis pa sa bslang ba ni/ gtor ma me tog spos dang ting lor bcas pa zhig a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang du bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i gtor snod kyi nang du/ oṃ las byung ba'i gtor ma yo byad thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hri/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa sarba sa pā ri wa ri bh+yaḥ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum nas bdun la sogs pa'i bar dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bhā ra sam+bhā ra hūṃ/ lan bdun/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gis bslang bar bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis rtsol/ lan gsum dang dril sil bya/ de rjes rol chen dang bcas te gtor ma phyir dor ro/ /de ni sgos kyi bdag po las bslang ba yin no/ /dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i dbus su maṇ+ḍal tshom bu mchod gtor dang bcas pa bshams/

bsangs sbyangs/ ṭak+ki ni hūṃ dza/ oṃ haṃ/ lan gsum/ haṃ gi sgra dang hūṃ gi 'od kyis bskul nas/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa byung*/ tshom bu'i steng du byon pa ni/ sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dkar po can/ kyai rig pa 'dzin pa dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bgyi ba bka' stsa la du gsol/ zhes gsungs par gyur/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a bdun las thod pa'i snod bdun gyi nang du hūṃ bdun las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas dang*/ gzhan yang mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyis gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ gi bar/ oṃ pri thi bī de bi bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ gi bar dang*/ ghaṇ+ḍe sogs/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hri/ gsum/ oṃ pri thi bī de bī bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi stobs bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ lan gsum/ kyai rig pa 'dzin pa dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar mdzod cig oṃ pri thi bī de bī bh+yaḥ

ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim par gyur/ de ni sa spyi'i bdag mo sa lha las bslang ba'o/ / gsum pa sa sbyang ba ni/ oṃ bhu khaṃ/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin gyur/ hūṃ la hūṃ/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ ni lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi kro dha satwa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas te yungs chu thal ba rnams gtor/ sa phyogs nam mkha' ltar spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes so/ / sbyin sreg gi sa sbyang ba byed na skabs 'dir bya/ bzhi pa bzung ba ni/ sa phyogs 'di bdag dpal phyag na rdo rje'i nyer spyod kyi gzhi yin no/ / sa phyogs 'di rdo rje'i gdan/ nga ni bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'o/ /sa phyogs 'di 'og min gyi zhing khams/ nga nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje lha bco brgyad kyi bdag nyid do/ / zhes blos gzung la/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir 'dug mchod pa bsham/ spros pa la mos na 'og nas 'byung ba ltar sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ bsdu na mchod pa byin rlabs tsam byas te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas gzung*/ / bzlas pa rdzogs kyi bar bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor kyi mngon rtogs rgyas pa yongs rdzogs bsgoms/ de nas phyogs kyi slob ma rnams kyis sngar gyi mchod pa kha gsos shing byin rlabs bya/ slob dpon gyis bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor la phul bar mos te/ /chu gsum nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa sngags tsam gyis phul/ khro mo bzhi'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog / dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung*/ /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog

/dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun kyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra u dhiṣ+ṭha/ dkyis 'khor nam mkha' la btegs gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rang nyid phyag gnyis par sprul/ a haṃ badz+ra pā ṇi/ mig g.yas su ma las nyi ma/ g.yon ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras hūṃ du gyur/ hūṃ hūṃ mang du brjod/ hūṃ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje'i stobs/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor bas/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ /lus gsum las skyes dges par bya/ / gal te kha cig bdag las 'da'/ /'dir ni 'jig 'gyur gzhan du min/ /mi dang mi min 'byung po'i tshogs/ /gdon gyi rigs su gtogs pa rnams/ /'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ sum+bha drag tu brjod/ hūṃ hūṃ zhes byang shar gyi mtshams nas g.yas su bskor bar bya'o/ / stangs stabs la sogs pa shes shing spro na skabs 'dir byed/ gzhung las/ bde mchog nag po dkyil chog dang mthun par bshad/ bsdu na med kyang chog go / oṃ badz+ra kī la ya sarba bi gha nan ban+dhu hūṃ phaṭa/ ces mang du bzlas pas phur bu byin gyis brlabs/ byang shar nas brtsams te phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'debs te/ sum+bha re re'i mthar/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba du ṣ+ta na phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra kī la badz+ra dha ro a dzña pa ya ti/ sarba bigh+nan kā ya wa ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa tshar re re brjod/ a r+gha la sogs pas mchod/ spos 'dug yungs dkar gtor/ brtan bzhugs bya/ mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar dkyil 'khor la gtor ma rgyas par 'bul lo/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad bzhi pa sta gon ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ku ṭa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/

oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hri/ lan gsum/ phai/ཾ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta pre ta pi sha tsa/ un+man+ta/ a pa smā ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the baṃ/ ya the ṣ+taṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi wa tha/ dzigh+ra tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba karta ya/ sad su kha/ bi shud+dha sa ha yi ka /bha wān+tu huṃ huṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ /dhu pa ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi te/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ klu yi= gnod sbyin= srin po'i= 'byung po'i= yi dwags= sha za'i= smyo byed= brjed byed= mkha' 'gro'i= ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /ma lus pa ni tham cad dag /'dir bshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis mchis pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*/ /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun kyis bka' drin bdag la rtsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ / dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yis/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la rtsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/

/'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang*/ 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phangs thob par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma la sogs pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ bgegs rnams bzlog cing 'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba rnams sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig sum+bha brjod/ gnas yo byin rlabs ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta= oṃ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang hūṃ yig las 'byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las gyur pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ yul nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong kyi bar du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra paṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi te/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra/ pra tsa li te/ pra dzñā pa ra mi ta/ nā da saṃ bha we/ badz+ra dharma hri da ya/ san+to ṣa ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swāhā/ zhes gnas yo byin gyis brlabs/ /bar 'dir tshogs pa yod cing spro na zhu 'bul bya/ de rjes skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ /gsang ba'i bdag po phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs rdzogs par bsgom te/ de dag ni sta gon gyi sngon du bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /'di nyid kyi gzhung las kyang*/ sa'i lha mo'i cho ga lan cig las ma gsungs shing*/ bla ma gong ma rnams sa lha sa chog gi skabs su song bas 'dir mi dgos gsung pa ltar ro/ /skabs 'dir sta gon dngos ni gsum ste/ bum pa dang lha dang slob ma sta gon no/ /dang po ni/ lha grangs dang mthun par byed na yab yum mnyam sbyor gyi dbang du byas nas dgu las bum dang bcu'o/ /drug tu byed na gtso bo la gcig phyogs bzhi'i lha la re re dang las bum mo/ /gsum byed na/ gtso bum dang*/ lha thams cad pa ste rnam rgyal dang*/ las bum mo/ /bsdu na bum pa gnyis kyis chog ste rnam rgyal dang las bum mo/ /de ltar na bum pa spyi dang mthun par bsham/

gzungs ring tshar gsum gyis bgegs dang byur bsal zhing byin gyis brlab/ / swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du/ a a las zla ba'i gdan re re/ de rnams kyi steng du bh+ruṃ bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir zhing*/ mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas gos kyi mgul bcings dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las su ཾ zhig spros te ri rab tu gyur/ hūṃ spros te 'khod pa las de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje gyur/ de'i lte bar paṃ las pad+ma'i sdong po pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lter bar/ bh+ruṃ las gzhal yas khang lha'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ tad+ya thā bho bho nas ṣ+ya ti hūṃ hūṃ/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung nas dga' bas brgyan pa'o/ /oṃ pa ra kra ma nas/ ba la ya phaṭa/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs bzhi la/ shar du khro bo chen po nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /oṃ ha ra ha ra nas nā sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ shar gyi sgo khyud kyi nas 'phrin las mdzad pa'o/ /las bum gyi nang du hūṃ las bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang khu/ phyag gnyis hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas khro bo'i rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin zhing*/ pad nyi la g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs par khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad dpal phyag na rdo rje lha bcu brgyad bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang bcas pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ a r+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho/ lha thams cad kyi spyir bor zla ba nas hūṃ mthing nag go /yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ / mi bskyod pa re res dbu rgyan par gyur/

yang ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ snying po'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ phyag na rdo rje drag po che/ sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ bum nang gi lha'i sku la thim pas 'od zer dmar pos khyab/ ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ gtso bo la bskyed sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzla dgos/ 'khor gyi sngags thung rnams nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzla zer te ci bde yin/ las bum la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ku ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces nyer gcig gam brgya rtsa bzla/ gal che shos med mi rung thun mong du gzungs ring nyer gcig dang*/ /snying po nye snying gnyis kyang ji ltar 'os pa bzla'o/ /bsdu na bzlas pa gzhan spangs te rtsa sngags kho nas kyang chog go /mthar a bhi ṣe ka ta bzlas shing gong bzhin mchod bstod yig brgya bzod gsol rnams byas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes bzla zhing dung gi chu blug lha rnams 'od du zhu zhing bum chu la thim par gyur/ smon lam dang bkra shis cung zad brjod/ /gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ sa gzhi'am maṇ+ḍal la lha'i bzhugs gnas kyi grangs bzhin du dril bzang gi thig le 'god de/ dbus su gru bzhi/ gzhan bcu gnyis su zlum por bkod/ mchod gtor rgya cher bsham/ thob thang la dri bzang gi thig le'i steng du me tog tshom bur 'god cing*/ /sngags re brjod rgyu yin yang*/ lag len mi bde na shoms kyi dus su/ thig le dang tshom bu bkod pas chog go /sa chog gi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg na/ de nyid spyan drangs te dmigs pas phab pa nyid kyis chog /sa chog gi skabs dkyil 'khor rang la bsdus pa'am/ rdul tshon la yang sa chog mi byed pa'am/ gal te ras bris yin na/ dam tshig pa bskyed dgos te/ gang ltar yang sa gzhi bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur/ tad+ya thā/ bho bho

nas ṣ+ya ti hūṃ hūṃ/ lan gsum/ dpal phyag na rdo rje dang yum mdzes ldan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pa ra kra ma ya phaṭa/ bi da ra ṇa ya phaṭa/ khro bo bdud las rgyal ba dang*/ lha mo 'od zer can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// kri tān+ta ya phaṭa/ kro dha satwa na ya phaṭa/ khro bo gzi brjid 'bar ba dang*/ lha mo mdangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kri tan+ta rū pa ya phaṭa/ nī la wa sa na ya phaṭa/ khro bo rngam pa sgra sgrog dang*/ lha mo sgra dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ro ṣa ṇa ya phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta ba la ya phaṭa/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang*/ lha mo rlung 'byin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ha ra ha ra/ ha sa ha sa/ rdo rje lcags kyu dang*/ lcags kyu ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ rdo rje zhags pa dang*/ zhags pa ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshin+dha tshin+dha mā ra ya mā ra ya/ rdo rje lcags sgrog dang*/ lcags sgrog ma la phyag 'tshal lo*/ / bhin+dha bhin+dha nā sha ya nā sha ya/ rdo rje dril bu dang*/ dril bu ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sngags de rnams so sor lan gsum gsum brjod/ nam mkha' nas 'bebs pa yin na/ sngags de rnams re re'i mthar a be sha ya a/ zhes btags pa tshar gcig brjod/ ye shes spyan 'dren mi dgos/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa yin na/ phyis ye shes spyan 'dren dgos so/ / srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i rin po che sna tshogs nas gdan re re yang grub par gyur/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po nas dga' bas brgyan pa'o/ /rtsibs bzhi la shar du khro bo/ nas bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /shar sgo'i sgo 'khyud nas 'phrin las mdzad pa'o/ / de nas ye shes spyan 'dren dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas btab byed na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa gnyis kyi gong ma nas/ dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes pa'o/ /de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bsangs sbyangs dang 'dod yon lnga'i bar rnams dngos gzhi'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/

de rjes/ oṃ a mṛ ta sogs nang mchod dang*/ shes rab thabs kyi sbyor ba yi sogs bstod pas bstod/ dngos gzhi'i skabs kyi bdag 'jug gi 'jug tu 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar/ nang gtor phul nas/ snyan gsan dbab par bya ste/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dgongs gsol/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*/ /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes bya yi/ /rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor 'bri/ /deng 'dir thams cad kun gshegs shig /dngos grub 'dir ni stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ snying po cung zad bzla/ oṃ badz+ra u dhiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces nam mkha' la bteg go /dkyil 'khor nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su zhugs shing*/ ā li kā la ི'i 'phreng bas rgyas 'debs zhes bla ma gong ma rnams gsungs so/ /de nas yig brgya bzlas/ smon lam dang bkra shis ji ltar 'os pa bya/ rjes chog gzhan mi dgos/ gsum pa slob ma sta gon ni/ 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur la/ lha gnas kyi nyin mo byed na/ gtor 'bul gyi gong 'og gnyis dang*/ dkyil 'khor nam mkhar btegs zin pa ste/ gnas skabs gsum po gang du byas kyang 'dra'o/ /de dag ni smar chen po'i dkyil chog dang*/ rgya gzhung gi yig sna sa bcad mdzad pa nas brtsams/ lugs 'di'i bod kyi bla ma rnams dkyil cho ga gzhan phal cher gung mthun pa'i phyag len brgyud pa'i rim pa yin zhing*/ dkyil chog spyi 'gro rnams dang go rim mthun pa'i phyir dang*/ lag len bde bar ngos 'dzin pa'i chos 'di 'dra'i rigs rnams man ngag gtso bor byed pa'i phyir dang*/ lag len gyi rgyun yin pa'i phyir/ lag len la ni rim pa de ltar bya'o/ /'on kyang gzhung gi dngos bstan la ni go rim gzhan du snang ste/ dkyil chog spyi la grags pa'i sa chog dang sta gon 'dres pa lta bur yod kyang*/ /rgya gzhungadangos bstan rang lugs la ni ma 'dres shing go rim ma 'chol ba ste/

de yang dkyil chog 'dir sa brtag pa mi gsungs/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid gzhung gzhan du bshad zin pa dang 'dra bar dgongs/ de na skabs 'dir bdag bskyed rgyas pa sngon du song nas gzhi bdag las sa bslang*/ sbyang ba la las dang sngags dang sbyin sreg dang*/ mtshan ma med pas sbyang ba'o/ /zhes gsungs/ dang po la lto 'phye ba rtag ces sho lo ka gcig gis rgyas bshad yod/ gzhan rnams la rgyas bshad ma mdzad de don gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ /sa bzung ba la blo dang lha yis sa bzung ngo*/ /zhes 'byung*/ dang po dkyus su bshad pa bzhin yin/ lha yi sa bzung ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la thod pa'i snod bzhag /lha tshogs kyi sngags brjod bzhin du/ der me tog dor bas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams skad cig gis byon nas/ sa gzhi bdag gir mdzad par bsam mchod bstod cig byas la mi dmigs par bsams/ dkyus kyi sa gzhi ni rdo rje gdan zhes sogs la'ang 'di'i don tshang ba tsam yin/ gzhung dngos las/ bzung ba gnyis la'ang rgyas bshad ma byung ngo*/ /de nas skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la bum pa rnams bshams te/ lha'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i maṇ+ḍal bris pa'i steng du 'god pa sogs yod/ bum sgrub ngo bo dkyus dang 'dra/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i steng du bum pa'i lha tshogs 'god pa nyid dkyil 'khor gyi lhas sa bzung ba'ang yin/ bum sgrub 'di kho nas chog la dgongs nas/ /sta gon gyi skabs su ma bshad do/ /sa srung ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg bdag nyid phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis bgegs la bka' bsgo ba dang*/ stang stabs thun mong gi srung 'khor tsam gsung te/ dra ba ra bar gyur pa'o//zhes pa yan chad sa chog yin/ de nas sa'i lha mo'i cho ga gsungs pa ni sa lha sta gon yin la/ 'dis don 'grub par dgongs nas sa chog gi skabs su sa lha'i cho ga med/

bod kyi bla ma rnams 'di la go zlog ste 'chad/ de nas slob dpon gyis mchod pa dang bcas te/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ zhes sogs phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la snyan mnan/ slob dpon gtso bor gsal ba la/ phyogs bzhi'i gsol 'debs byed/ de rjes lha sta gon dngos ni/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor phab/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren sogs byed pa'o/ /de'i 'phros la gsal kha ma byung yang/ thig tshon gyi sngon du dkyil 'khor nam mkhar 'degs pa bshad pa skabs 'dir blangs kyang rung*/ gzhung gi dngos bstan ni/ lha rnams bzhugs bzhin pa la sngar bsgrub pa'i bum pa rnams spyan drangs te bzlas pa dngamachod bstod byas/ las bum gyis gnas dang yo byad thams cad la bsangs gtor tsam bya'o/ /de nas yol bas bcad de/ de nub mchod pa mtshan thub yod par byed/ snyan gsan dbab pa ma gsungs mod/ gsang ba spy-i rgyud las 'byung bas byas kyang legs/ gang ltar yang nang par snga bar mchod bstod byas nas dkyil 'khor nam mkhar 'degs/ de nas thig tshon gyi las rnams bya'o/ /bum pa sta gon gyi skabs 'dir bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i bum pa la/ zhes pa'i tshig 'byung bas/ bum sgrub la brten nas bsnyen pa kha gso byed par/ zur gyis bstan par mngon yang*/ sa bzung ba dang*/ srung ba'i bar du bsnyen pa yod don med pas/ gzhung gi dkyus su bshad pa de ni lha yis sa bsrung ba yin gyi bsnyen pa min no/ /'o na gzhung du/ de nas bum pa'i snying po ni/ /'bum tsho gcig tu bsnyen pa 'bul/ /dus dang grangs dang mtshan ma yi/ /thun mtshams sbyor ba re re la/ /gtso ba'i bsnyen pa brgya ru 'bul/ /'khor la lnga bcu rim gyis 'bul/ zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ bum bsnyen bstan pa yin snyam na/ bsnyen pa brgya ru 'bul zhes pa/ bzlas pa dang bsnyen pa'i dbye ba ma phyed pas skye bo blun po'i kha rgyugs shor 'dug cing*/ gzhi'i bsnyen pa yin na bum pa la brten pa mi 'thad/

slob ma'i bsnyen pa kha gsor grags pa de yin na dus dang zhes pa mi 'thad/ /'dir 'bum dang brgya dang lnga bcu zhes 'byung ba/ gong du 'phreng ba'i sngags ni rtsa gcig bzlas/ zhes pa dang 'gal zhing*/ bum pa'i snying po ngos gzung du med pa sogs tshig don gnyis ka mi legs pa kho nar snang bas/ rang bzo mkhan gyis lhad bcug pa'i tshig yin par mngon no/ /'og tu bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i bum pa la zhes pa yang*/ bsnyen pa dang dbang gi bum sgrub gnyis po cho ga 'dra ba'i don yin pas/ bum pa ltar zhes pa'i don du 'chad dgos so/ /gzhan du na/ byin gyis brlab la sogs pa nas/ zhes gsungs pas/ bum bsnyen grub pa la slar byin gyis brlob mi dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ bum bsnyen gyi bum pas phyis dbang bskur na ha cang thal zhing*/ bum bsnyen byed pa'i lag len gzhan kun dang yang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /yang rnam pa gcig tu na bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i bum pa la byin gyi brlab la sogs pa nas/ mchod pa yan chad rdzogs par bya/ zhes pa 'di yang*/ de nas bum pa'i snying po ni/ sogs kyi gzhug 'thud pa'i phyir rang bzor bcug pa min na rung ste/ zhes brtag par yang bya'o/ /yang kha cig 'di snyam du gzhung gi dngos bstan gyi go rim 'di kho na bzhin byed ba ni mi rung ste/ phyogs bzhi gsol btab ni/ sa chog gi skabs bgegs la bka' bsgo ba'i sngon du dgos kyi/ sta gon gyi skabs su mi rung ngo snyam na dkyil chog gzhan dang bstun na de skad ces smra ba bden du rung yang*/ 'di dang dkyil chog gzhan la skabs 'di dag tu mi 'dra ba cher yod pas lugs tha dad nyid kyi phyir/ de de 'god par mi nus so/ /phyogs bzhi gsol gdab 'di gang nas bshad pa'i rtsa bar rang gi khungs ni/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i le'u bzhi pa yin la/ der ni gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang sgrub cing mchod pa tsam zhig gsungs kyi/

sa chog gi sgos chos yin par gsungs pa med pas/ rtsa ba'i khungs rgyud dang ni mi 'gal te/ 'dir yang dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i sngon du byed pas so/ /de la dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ zhes pa ni/ dkyil 'khor sprul zhing bshad du gsol/ zhes pa yin na/ 'dir lta sta dgon nas brtsams te/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor sprul pa yin par dgongs pas de dang sbrel ba yin gyi don med du bkrugs pa ni ma yin no/ /des na dkyil chog rgya gzhung gi dngos bstan kho na la go rim bsgyur ba med par lag len byas na yang 'di nyid kyi rang lugs yin pa'i phyir legs so snyam pa ni bdag gi rnam par rtog pa'o/ /grub thob dza ba ri pa rang gi dgongs pa'ang khong rang gi gzhung gi dngos bstan nyid yin dgos te/ rgyud rnams su ni cho ga'i rim pa 'thor thabs dang 'khrugs can du 'byung ba yin gyi/ dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos chog sgrigs su bsgrigs pa 'di dag ni 'thor ba bsdus 'khrugs pa bsal zin pa yin pas/ 'di dag la'ang 'khrugs sdebs dgos na ha cang thal bar 'gyur te/ bod du byas pa'i dkyil chog rnams la'ang 'khrugs sdebs dgos par mi 'gyur ram/ yang gzhung 'di nyid kho na'i dbang du byas pa la yang sa chog dang*/ sta gon 'khrugs can du yod na slob ma dbang bskur la yang yod dgos pa las/ slob ma sta gon gyi rim pa dang*/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur la dngos bstan gyi go rim bzhin byed du rung ba'i phyir/ sa chog dang sta gon la yang rung ba nyid de rgyu mtshan rnam pa kun tu mtshungs so/ /des na gzhung gi dngos bstan mi rung ngo zhes smra bar mi bya la/ gzhung gi dngos bstan kyang bya rung*/ sgyur byed lo paṇa gnyis kyi man ngag 'di yang rung*/ 'on kyang da lta byin rlabs 'byung ba'i rgyun yod bzhin pa yin pas lo paṇa gyi man ngag lugs la lag len byed zer na legs pa yin no/
/dza ba ri pa rang gi man ngag ni khong rang gi gzhung ltar byed pa nyid las gzhan 'os med kyang phyis lo paṇa rnams kyis kyang gnang ba thob par shes par bya'o/

/gsum pa dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga ni/ nang par snga bar thig tshon rnams 'dus byas/ tshon lnga po la rigs lnga'i sa bon bris/ dbus su sngon po shar du dkar po sogs 'god/ tshon gyi steng du so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i thig skud kyang 'jog ste/ byin rlabs phyogs gcig tu byed pa'i lugs su 'dug spyir gzhung rnams las so sor byin rlabs byed par gsungs shing*/ 'di nyid kyi gzhung las kyang gsal mod/ phyogs gcig tu byed pa'i lag len ka mang bar byung 'dug bla chos su thal ba'i nyes skyon cung zad yong srid na'ang rnam pa gcig tu na 'gal ba cher med do/ /mchod pa lnga dang nang mchod bsham/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i mngon rtogs gtor chog dang bcas pa song na legs/ min na'ang rang skad cig gis gtso bor bskyed nas bzlas pa cung zad bya/ thig tshon a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ sā bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thig tshon sngon po hūṃ las mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thig tshon dkar po oṃ las rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thig tshon ser po traṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan gser mdog rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thig tshon dmar po hri las 'od dpag med byi ru'i mdangs can pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thig tshon ljang khu khaṃ las don yod grub pa margad 'od can ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rang snang gi yum gyis 'khyud pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/

de bzhin du/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥ hūṃ / nas shap+ta 'i bar nang mchod sngar byin rlabs ma byas na 'dir byed/ hūṃ oṃ traṃ hriṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes lan gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ hūṃ oṃ traṃ hriṃ khaṃ/ zhes lan nyer gcig gam brgya rtsa sogs ci ltar 'os pa bzlas/ rgyal ba rigs lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon rnams su gyur/ thig skud rnams phyogs gcig tu bzhag la brkyang*/ oṃ badz+ra su tra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ lan mang du brjod/ rdul tshon mtheb srin gyis mnye zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ mang du brjod/ slob ma rdo rje lha mo mdzes ldan mar gyur/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharma pa raspa ra a nu pra priṣ+ta sarba dharmaḥ ar+yan+ta a nu pra priṣ+ta sarba dharmaḥhūṃ/ zhes thig skud bsgril lo/ /'di nyid kyi gzhung na sngags 'di'i gsal kha med pas sngags 'di byed phyin spyi dang mthun par byed pa legs so/ /de nas dz+dza dz+dza zhes thig sna slob ma la gtad*/ nam mkha' gang ba'i bde gshegs rnams/ /khyed kyis 'gro don mdzad dus lags/ /thig skud sgra yis bskul nas ni/ /thams cad 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ oṃ āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes thig chen brgyad po steng dang 'og tu gdab/ nub shar lho byang me dbang dang*/ /rlung srin rlung dbang me srin po/ /me rlung srin 'byung zhes bya'o/ /de'i rjes su las thig rnams btab/ snying po bzla bzhin du/ slob dpon gyis dang por dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa nas 'bri ste/ de nas gzhan rnams kyis bgyi ste spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di dag ni gzhung la kha 'gengs byas pa man ngag gi lugs yin no/ /gzhung gi dngos bstan ni/ thig skud la ye shes kyi thig skud stim pa tsam dang*/ thig sna 'dren pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ swāhā sa thig 'debs pa dang*/ rdul tshon stong pa'i ngang las yig 'bru lnga/

ye shes kyi rdul tshon spyan drangs te bstims pas rdul tshon du gyur/ de nas tshon 'gyed pa tsam ma gtogs ma gsungs/ rdul tshon rigs lnga'i sa bon las bskyed par gsungs pas/ thig skud kyang rigs lnga'i sa bon las bskyed pa tsam go bar nus/ kha 'gengs ma byas par gzhung gi dngos bstan 'di kho nas kyang chog par sems so/ /bris zin nas thig tshon gyi lhag ma la mchod bstod gshegs gsol bya ste spyi dang 'dra/ de nas rgyan sna tshogs dgram ste/ sa stegs kyi grwa bzhi la ral gri dang*/ mda' dang*/ me long rnams bzhi bzhi 'god par bshad/ gong bzhin sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ sgrub thabs ltar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom ste/ bcom ldan 'das ma yang gtso bo'i thugs kar bsdu/ zhal phyag lhag ma rnams kyang rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūṃ/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te dang po bum pa 'god/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa yod na rang rang gi gnas su 'god par bshad kyang*/ /lag len mi bde bas so sor 'jog pa'i stang ka tsam byas la/ gtso bo'i bum pa shar sgo'i g.yas la nye ba dang*/ gzhan rnams rang rang gi phyogs dang 'brel bar phyi rol du 'god/ bum pa gnyis kyi phyogs la rnam rgyal bum pa shar sgo'i g.yas su 'god cing las bum ni rnam pa kun tu byang shar du'o/ /yang go skabs dog pas 'god stabs mi bde ba dang*/ ras bris kyi phyogs la ni stegs bu gzhan la bzhag pas rung ba'i phyir/ bum pa 'god pa'i cho ga 'di nges par dgos pa'ang ma yin no/ /de rjes mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs nas/ bgegs sbyang ba gsum dang*/ sdig sgrib sbyang ba dang*/ las bum gyis khrus gsol byed pa rnams spyi dang mthun par bya/ gzhung du tshogs gsog gnyis byed par gsungs pa ni/

dngos gzhi'i thog mar bdag bskyed rgyas pa mi byed pa la dgongs/ de yang nus pa dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyi dbang du byas nas/ dkyil chog rgya gzhung phal cher la yang bdag bskyed rgyas pa med mod kyang*/ /byin rlabs 'jug pa'i khyad che ba'i phyir dang*/ dkyil 'khor phal cher gyi da lta'i lag len la bdag bskyed rgyas pa yod pa ltar 'dir yang ste/ des na tshogs bsags gnyis dang*/ de nas bdag nyid hū ཾ du bsam/ zhes pa skabs 'dir bsgom mi dgos so/ / mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swā bhā wa sa sbyangs/ oṃ shu n+ya ta sogs/ rang gi thugs ka nas raṃ chad pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ hūṃ bsnol ma chad pa las zhes pa nas/ gdan re re'ang grub par gyur/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ hūṃ yig zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su hūṃ de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las/ lha mtshan gtso bo yab yum gyi rnam par gyur/ sgo 'byed pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra uta gha ṭa sa ma ya hūṃ/ lan bzhi sgo bzhi rang bye bar gyur/ rang nyid gzhal yas khang chen po'i shar sgo nas zhugs te/ dbus kyi mtshan ma'i lha dang gnyis su med par gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las zhes pa nas/ mdangs can gyi phung por gyur/ de nyid cha bco brgyad du gyur/ dbus kyi cha gnyis thig le dkar dmar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rnam par gyur/ zla ba rdo rje dang*/ nyi ma thod khrag tu gyur/ thod khrag gi nang du rdo rje phyed nub tsam/ de las bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje yum lha mo mdzes ldan ma'i 'khyud pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus shing gcig tu 'dres pa rang nyid la thim pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung

zhes pa nas/ dga' bas brgyan pa'o/ / 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la mdzad pa mi dgos/ bdag skyed ltar spro ba yin pas/ byang chub kyi sems cha brgyad/ thig le dkar dmar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rnam pa bzhir gyur/ zhes pa nas/ g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa' ོ'i bar dang*/ de ltar 'khor bco brgyad po thams cad kyang ni yi ge 'bru gsum la thim/ yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sta gon gyi lha rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can sogs gong bzhin/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ gong bzhin mchod nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sgrub mchod zhag sbrel gyi nyi ma phyi ma rnams la mi dgos/ yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ nas/ mi bskyod pa re res dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin las/ bdag la rigs shes par/ zhes pa la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la rigs shes pa/ zhes 'don pa spo/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can du yongs su bye ste/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar sgo'i phyogs su gnas pas mchod pa'i las mdzad par 'gyur/ amṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon nas shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shā sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum/ hūṃ rab mchog bdud rtsi ar+gha'i rgyun/ /dwangs shing gsal la ro mchog ldan/ /rab tu dgyes shing tshim byed 'di/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra pā ṇi maṇ+ḍal de ba ta sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ rab tu dwangs shing dri ma med/ /yan lag brgyad ldan spos kyi chu/ /phyag dang zhabs dang bsil ba'i phyir/ /'bul gyi mgon pos bzhes su gsol/ pād+yaṃ= ha ri tsan dan brdar ba'i chab/

/lha rdzas dri zhim kun dang sbyar/ /'gro kun gdung ba sel slad du/ /'thor 'thung 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol/ añdza ma naṃ= hūṃ me tog dam pa 'di dag dang*/ /de bzhin mdzes pa'i me tog kun/ /bde gshegs sku la 'bul bar bgyi/ /chags med thugs rjes bzhes su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra pā ṇi maṇ+ḍal de ba ta sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra puṣ+pe pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i bdug spos ni/ /gtso bo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /rtog med thugs rjes bzhes su gsol/ badz+ra dhu pe= mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms byed cing*/ /phyogs kun gsal ba'i mar me 'di/ /kun mkhyen ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /ye shes thugs mchog bzhes su gsol/ badz+ra ā lo ke= lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /dri yi mchod pa 'di dag ni/ /rang byung thugs la dbul bar bgyi/ /kun bzang thugs rjes bzhes su gsol/ badz+ra gan+dhe= kha tog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ /bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag /rang rig ye shes bsnyes phyir 'bul/ badz+ra nai wi te= bla med theg pa mchog gi don ston pa/ / shes rab mchog gi rjes 'gro rol mo'i sgra/ /bdud kyi 'khor lo gzhom phyir dbul bar bgyi/ /thugs rjes 'gro la mnga' brnyes 'di bzhes shig /badz+ra sha p+ta 'bud dkrol bya/ de nas gos zung dang*/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon lnga la sogs pa tshigs bcad rnams spyi khyab tu grags pa la rigs mi 'dra ba du ma yod pas ji ltar 'os pa dang sbyor zhing*/ sngags kyi 'don pa bsgyur tshul gong du bshad pas rigs 'gre'o/ /bar 'dir phyi rol gtor ma gtong ste/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol du dkar gtor dmar gtor mchod pa dang bcas pa bsham/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i gtor snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/

oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod rgu'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan mang du brjod cing*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum bya/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su hūṃ las skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po bzhugs par gyur/ phyi rol rim pa dang po la phuḥyig brgyad las klu brgyad/ rim pa gnyis pa la hūṃ brgyad las bdud rgyal yi dwags chen po brgyad/ gsum pa la k+ṣa yig brgyad las gnod sbyin chen po brgyad/ phyi rol du phyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa srid pa gsum kyi 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ drag po gsum gyi lha tshogs srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dza/ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ nor rgyas dung skyong ser po shar zhes pa nas/ gnod sbyin 'khor sde lnga brgyar bcas/ dam rdzas gtor ma 'di long zhig ces pa'i bar bya/ de rjes/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sogs 'kha' 'gro spyi gtor bzhin bsngos nas/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig gi bar du bya/ mchod yon 'bul ba'i sngags brjod pa med gzhan lag len spyi dang mthun/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis mtshams bcad/ nang du yongs nas/ rang nyid zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i skur gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ zhes brjod do/ /nang mchod ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta kun+ṭa li nas gzung*/ nang mchod byin rlabs dang*/ oṃ nī laṃ sogs la i daṃ sogs spyar bas gtso bo la 'bul ba'i bar yang sgrub thabs bzhin/ oṃ pa ra kra ma ya phaṭa/ sogs sngags re re'i mthar 'bru gsum btags te 'bul/ ha ra ha ra hūṃ phaṭa/ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes sogs sbyor ba yin/ de bzhin du spyi 'gro'i tshig rnams kyang sbyar te/ mgron sna tshogs pa rnams la 'bul/

deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ zhes pa nas/ byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ āḥ zhes pa'i bar sgeg sogs brgyad kyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ gsang ba'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas rgya cher spel la/ snang stong sgyu ma lta bur shes pas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ nas/ 'on kyangaskyobs pa'i sras su skye/ zhes brjod de bla na med pa'i mchod pa'o/ / hūṃ thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba yi/ zhes pa nas/ las kun sgrub la bstod/ ces pas bstod do/ /spros pa la dga' na bstod pa rgyas pa 'dis kyang bstod par bya ste/ hūṃ rang bzhin mkha' ltar khyab pa chos kyi dbyings/ /stug po bkod pa'i gnas mchog dam pa na/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gtso bo mi bskyod mgon/ /byang chub lnga ldan sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog tu/ /thugs rje 'gro rnams 'dren mdzad gsang ba'i rgyal/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /ris med ye shes chos kyi dbyings su zhugs/ /rnam shes 'khor bcas dag pa'i chos kyi sku/ /zhe sdang rnam dag zhe sdang chen po'i sku/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gyur med sku ni nam mkha'i kha dog 'dra/ /sku gsum rnam par dag pa'i zhal ras gsum/ /rnam par dag pa'i spyan gsum me 'od 'phro/ /phyag drug pha rol phyin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /che ba'i yon tan rgyas pa'i dbu skra 'bar/ /rdo rje rtse lnga ye shes lnga dang ldan/ /sdigs mdzub ma rtogs 'gro la thar lam ston/ /sa steng gnod sbyin 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/

/zung 'jug thal mos bdag lta'i ri bo 'joms/ /'gro ba'i zhe sdang 'joms phyir sbrul gdug gsol/ /nam mkha' rgyu ba'i bdud dpung 'joms mdzad cing*/ / sa 'og klu tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku sbom gsus khyim rgyas pa chos nyid klong*/ /zhabs g.yas bskums pas 'khor ba rtag mtha' spangs/ /g.yon pa bskyangs bas myang 'das chad mtha' bsal/ /tshangs dang brgya byin mnan la phyag 'tshal lo/ kha na ma tho spangs pa'i chos gos sngo/ /stag lpags lhan skyes byang sems gshin rje 'dul/ /sbrul gyis brgyan pas nyon mongs dug gsum dag /'dod dgu'i 'phrin las stsol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i yum mchog rdo rje mā ma kī /mdzes ldan lha mo mnyam nyid byang chub sems/ /rnam dag nam mkha'i khams kyi ngo bo nyid/ /shes rab pha rol phyin la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gzugs can snang ba chos kyi dbyings su thim/ /sku yi mdzad pa snang stong sgyu ma'i ngang*/ /'gro ba'i gti mug dra ba 'joms mdzad pa/ khro chen bdud las rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /myong ba'i tshogs kun mnyam nyid thugs rje'i ngang*/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan rin chen 'od zer 'bar/ /nga rgyal ser sna'i dra ba 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje khro bo gzi brjid la phyag 'tshal/ /'dzin byed dag pa so sor rtog pa'i dngos/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi gsang ba can/ /brtse ba'i 'od kyis 'dod chags rgya mtsho skem/ /khro rgyal rngam pa sgra sgrog la phyag 'tshal/ /bya ba sgrub mdzad las rnams kun la khyab/ de bzhen gshegs pa kun kyi 'phrin las mgon/ /phrag dog nags tshal ye shes 'bar bas bsregs/ /legs mdzad bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam par dag pa sa yi khams/ /byams pa tshad med ngo bo nyid/ /gdug can kun la phur bus 'debs/ /'od zer can ma la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam par dag pa chu yi khams/ /snying rje tshad med ngo bo nyid/ / gdug pa can rnams rengs shing gnon/ /mdangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/

/ rnam par thar pa me yi khams/ /dga' ba tshad med ngo bo nyid/ /'gro ba ma lus dbang du mdzad/ /sgra dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam par dag pa rlung gi khams/ btang snyoms tshad med ngo bo nyid/ /'phrin las ma lus sgrub mdzad ma// rdo rje rlung 'byin la phyag 'tshal/ /shes rab dang bcas dad pa'i stobs/ /ma rig chu bo skem mdzad cing*/ /'gugs byed rdo rje lcags kyu dang*/ /lcags kyu ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab dang bcas brtson 'grus stobs/ / srid pa'i sbyor ba 'joms mdzad cing*/ /'ching byed rdo rje zhags pa dang*/ /zhags pa mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab dang bcas dran pa'i stobs/ /'dod pa'i zag pa 'joms mdzad cing*/ /sdom byed rdo rje lcags sgrog dang/ /lcags sgrog ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab dang bcas ting 'dzin stobs/ /lta ba ngan pa'i nyer len 'joms/ /'babs byed rdo rje dril bu dang*/ /dril bu ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / kun gzhi gnas gyur dag pa'i klong*/ /rnam dag ye shes 'jig rten khams/ / rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa yi/ /gzhal med khang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las dang nyon mongs sna tshogs kyi/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul ba'i sems can rnams/ /rdo rje'i gnas la 'god pa'i rtags/ /dur khrod brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi 'gyur don dam ye shes mchog /kun tu khyab par 'bar ba yi/ /bla med srung ba'i 'khor lo la/ /bdag yid dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs shes nyi zla kha sbyor 'phro 'du las/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba'i ngang tshul gyi/ /dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa la/ /gnyis med tshul gyis gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bstod pa'i dge ba'i bdag cag rnams/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus 'joms nus pa'i*/ /thugs kyi rdo rje gsang ba'i bdag po yi/ / go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par shog / ces so/ /bar 'dir nus na sbyin sreg gi mchod pas kyang mchod par bya mod/ ma grub kyang 'gal ba med/

de rjes mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa ji ltar 'os pa byas te/ bde bar gshegs pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos sgrub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ bden stobs brjod de/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du byung*/ /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*/ /bden pa de yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog lan gsum brjod do/ /sdoms ni/ khrus byas maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab sdom pa bzung*/ /lhar bskyed gdong g.yogs bsangs byed sems bskyed bya/ gsang gdam dam chu sbyin te phyi 'jug yin/ nang 'khrid skor ba gsol btab ye shes dbab/ brtan byed gsang gdams bka' mnyan me tog dor/ /me tog 'ching dang nam mkha'i kha dog brtag /gdong dbye lha ngo ston pa nang 'jug yin/ zhes sdoms blo la nges par bya'o/ /dang po khrus ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ abhi ṣe ka ta sogs brjod/ slob ma dbang skur la ni/ khrus byas te me tog bkye bsdu sems bskyed gsal 'debs rnams yin/ gnyis pa ni 'jug pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gsum pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ bzhi pa ni/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ zhes pa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ kyi bar rigs lnga'i sdom bzung spyi dang mthun/ lnga pa lhar bskyed pa ni/ rang skad gcig gis bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa stag lpags dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ zhes brjod/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs/ rang nyid ces pa khyed rang rnams su 'don pa spo ste/ 'di thams cad la rigs 'gre'o/ /'jug pa'i skabs su lus kyi spyod pa dang mthun pa'i sku'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs su 'pho bas/

g.yon brkyang sogs kyi nges can 'dir mi bzhed cing*/ phyag mtshan yang skabs 'dir mi mdzad pa'i lugs so/ /drug pa mig dar bcing ba ni/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ/ bdun pa bsangs ba ni/ rdo rje gsor zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs las bum gyi chus gtor ro/ /brgyad pa sems bskyed pa ni/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ brtse ba snying rje chen po dang stong nyid ye shes rdo rje dbyer med pa'i byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra yo ka tsit+ta u pa da ya mi/ rdo rje snying gar bzhag su ra te sa ma ya stāṃ/ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ dgu pa dkyil 'khor gsang gdams ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /ma mthong snod dang mi ldan pa/ /su la'ang ston par ma byed cig ces rdo rje spyi bor bzhag bcu pa dam chu sbyin pa ni/ nang mchod bsang ste/ 'di ni rdo rje dam tshig chu/ /srungs shig ma srungs sreg par byed/ /srungs na dngos grub ster byed pa/ /bdud rtsi 'di ni myang bar gyis/ oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u ta ka ṭha ṭha ṭha/ de dag ni byis 'jug yin pas slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi'am yol ba'i phyi rol du bya'o/ /bcu gcig pa nang 'jug gi thog ma yol ba'i nang du 'khrud pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i las kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyag gi rdo rje la 'jus te srung 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ bcu gnyis pa skor ba dang phyag 'tshal ni/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byas par mos/ oṃ na maḥ te hūṃ/ na maḥme hūṃ*/ na mo na maḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes shar sgo nas phyag 'tshal bar mos/ bcu gsum pa ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/

dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal phyag na rdo rje bdag la dbab par mdzod cig lan gsum/ bcu bzhi pa ye shes dbab pa ni/ 'khor ba thams cad ni sdug bsngal/ 'dus byas thams cad ni mi rtag /snang zhing srid pas chos thams cad ni sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po thams cad bla ma dang 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis phyag na rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i skur gsal ba'i rkang pa'i 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can gyi rgyud gyen du bstan pa la rkang pa gnyis bzhag pa/ spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po sku la phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ nyams bde ba chen po dang ldan par bzhugs/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma'i ngo bo aḥyig las/ 'bar ba'i gtum mo tsaṇ+ḍa li'i me lce tshon gang tsam du 'phags/ rkang 'og gi gzhu g.yo ba'i zhugs kyis rang nyid gyen du 'degs bzhin pa dang*/ gtum mo'i gdung ba'i 'od kyis lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ spyi bo'i bla ma'i thugs ka nas aḥyig dmar po char babs pa bzhin byon/ snying ga nas zhugs lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab/ dkyil 'khor kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad dpal phyag na rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs shing thim par gyur/ tad+ya thā/ bho bho nas/ ṣ+ya ti hūṃ/ badz+ra a be sha a a/ zhes brjod cing rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /bco lnga pa brtan par bya ba ni/ dkyil 'khor kyi gtso bo'am/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying gar sangs rgyas gos sngon can du gyur/ snying ga'am spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag /oṃ nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi tsit+ta maṇ+ḍa

la badz+ra sa ma ya/ ti ṣ+ṭhan+tu/ bcu drug pa lha sngags gsang bar gdams pa ni/ mthu stobs phyag na rdo rje ni/ /khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /rtag tu yi dam lha yin gyi/ /tshul 'di smra bar ma byed cig /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ bcu bdun pa bka' mnyan par gdams pa ni/ nga ni phyag na rdo rje ste/ /nga yis bsgo ba nyan par gyis/ /nga la brnyes par ma byed cig /gal te khyod kyi bsnyan na ni/ /dam tshig 'di yis sreg par byed/ /tsha ba chen po'i gnas su ltung*/ bco brgyad me tog 'bul ba ni/ mthu stobs mnga' bdag dkyil 'khor du/ /rig pa'i me tog 'di phul bas/ /sngon tshe ye shes bsnyes pa'i lha/ /gang yin de la 'bab par shog /oṃ pra tits+tsha badz+ra ho/ bcu dgu pa me tog 'ching ba ni/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa swa mi maṃ satā mahā ba la/ nyi shu pa nam mkha'i kha dog brtag pa ni/ rang gi las dang rjes su mthun pa'i kha dog mthong bar gyur/ ces brjod/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs/ skabs 'dir dri lan byed pa lag len mi bde ba'i me tog 'dor ba'i sngon du byed pa spyi dang 'dra ba'i lag len yod pa ltar 'gal ba med do/ /yig rnying 'ga' re dang*/ sngon gyi lag len zhig la skabs 'dir gsang ming 'dogs pa'i srol zhig byung ba/ snying ma ba'i lag len 'chugs pa ni min nam/ gang ltar mkhas pa rnams phyag len mi mdzad pas reg zhig lag len mi byed la/ rnying ma la de ltar byed pa la yang dgos pa cig yod do/ /nyer gcig pa gdong dbye ba ni/ rang bzhin rnam dag bdag nyid kyi/ /dpa' bo dbang phyug ma yi gnas/ /dri med rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni/ / bu khyod kyis ni lta bar gyis/ oṃ dzñā na tsak+ṣu hūṃ aḥ nyer gnyis pa lha ngo bstan pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur/

zhes brjod/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs mngon rtogs ltar zhib mor bstan na legs so/ /de nas dngos gzhi las/ slob ma'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ sdoms ni/ gsol gdab dbang lha spyan 'dren dang*/ /chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang*/ /dril bu ming dang sngags dbang dang*/ /brtul zhugs rgyan dang dbugs dbyung dang*/ /lung bstan rnams su shes par bya/ dang po ni/ bsam gyis mi khyab chos kyi snod/ /dbang bskur dam pa mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ gnyis pa ni/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa yod na/ 'khor gyi bum chu rnams rnam rgyal bum par bsdu/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' sems ma/ ye shes khro bo khro mo thams cad badz+ra sa mā dza/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ nas shap+ta 'i bar/ phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la/ 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*/ yon tan 'byung nas ji ltar stsal/ de bzhin 'di la gnang bar zhu/ lan gsum/ gsum pa ni/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ gnyis ka'ang hūṃ las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon da ེ sa yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ cung zad khro bo'i nyams can/ dar dngarin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ skabs 'dir rgyas pa la mos na/ dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur rgyas gdab dang mchod bstod bya/

bsdu na mi dgos/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba= sogs bkra shis tshig brjod/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang bskur bar gyur/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing*/ sku gsum dam tshig las byung ba/ /ye shes bdud rtsi dri ma med/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /mi bskyod pas ni dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ā dar sha dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa ya mi/ bum chu btung*/ de ltar dbang bskur bas sdig sgrib thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba mi bskyod par gyur pas dbus brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ gong du dbang rdzas dang slob ma la lhan cig tu mchod pa phul nas/ 'dir slob ma'i mchod pa mi byed pa'i lugs kyang yod do/ /lag len dkyus ltar bya'o/ / de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhes sdang dag rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal pa can du byas so/ /

sdoms ni/ bsangs sbyang sngon du 'gro ba yi/ /lhar bskyed byin rlabs ye shes dgug /dbang rdzas zhu zhing shis pa brjod/ /dbang bskur mchod dang rtogs pa bskyed/ /chu dbang bskur ba'i sdoms yin te/ /shis brjod ma gtogs cod pan sogs/ /phyi ma bzhi la'ang 'dra ba yin/ /brtan byed chu dbang lhag por bskur/ zhes go bar bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni bsangs sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te/ gnyis ka'ang aṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po g.yas rin po che dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i= yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa= sangs rgyas thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam pa spyan drangs= dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ dbu rgyan bcings dar dbyangs bskon bzhin du/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che/ /dbu rgyan rin chen bla na med/ /rin chen kun gyi mchog 'gro ba/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma tā dzñā na rat+na swa bhā wa hūṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ bum chus spyi bor gtor la/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ de ltar dbang bskur bas= zhes dang*/ spyi bor 'khyil ba rin chen 'byung ldan du gyur pas dbu brgyan= cod pan gyi dbang = ser sna= tshor ba'i phung po= mnyam pa nyid kyi= rin chen 'byung ldan gyi= zhes 'don pa spo/ gzhan thams cad chu dbang dang 'dra/ de kho nas phyi ma gsum la rigs 'gre ste/ lnga pa ni/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje= dz+riṃ las 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po g.yas pad+ma dang = yum gos dkar mo dmar mo= sangs rgyas thams cad 'od dpag med kyi= dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med= dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsang ba las/ chos rnams kun gyi sgor gyur pa'i/ rdo rje chos kyi dbang bskur ro/

/oṃ badz+ra pra ti be da dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ= spyi bor 'khyil ba 'od dpag med du gyur pas= 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang = 'dod chags= 'du shes kyi phung po= so sor rtog pa'i ye shes= 'od dpag med kyi= zhes 'don pa spo/ drug pa ni/ dbang rdzas dril bu= khaṃ las don yong grub pa sku mdog ljang khu/ g.yas ral gri= /yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu= thams cad don yod grub pa'i= dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa= dril bur gyur/ shes rab thabs dang ldan pa yi/ /'gro don mnyam med byed pa dang*/ /mchod pa'i las rnams rdzogs byed pa'i/ /dril bu lus kyi dbang skur ro/ /oṃ kṛ t+yā nu ṣ+ṭhan dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ri= don yod grub par gyur pas= don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i= phrag dog= 'du byed kyi phung po= bya ba sgrub pa'i= don yod grub pa'i= zhes 'don pa spo/ bdun pa ni/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bu mi dmigs te/ bh+ruṃ las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas 'khor lo= yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo= sangs rgyas thams cad rnam par snang mdzad kyi= dbang rdzas kyi rnam par snang mdzad= rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /cis kyang mi shigs mi g.yo ba/ /rdo rje'i ming du rab tu bsgrags/ oṃ tri tsakra dharma dhā tu dzñā na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ kyai dpal/ phyag na rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ri bha wa= rnam par snang mdzad du gyur pas= rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas= gti mug= gzugs kyi phung po= chos dbyings ye shes= rnam par sna mdzad gyi go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal pa can du byas so/ / zhes 'don pa spo/ brgyad pa ni/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar/ ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis sngags mchod phul/

thig le'i rang bzhin mi shigs pa/ kha sbyor nyi zla'i 'phro 'du las/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag 'joms mdzad pa/ /'khor lo'i bdag po khyod la bstod/ oṃ nī lām+ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇa hri da ya/ mahwa kro rda sa twa hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ bcom ldan bdag gi bzung lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'di la sbyin lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ 'di la slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs ni/ slob dpon gyis bzlas pa cung zad byas nas/ lag len gsung gi rjes gnang bzhin byed do/ /dgu pa ni/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa zhabs g.yon brkyang gi bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/ dpral bar= nas sangs rgyas thams cad phyag na rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje lag pa g.yas su gtad/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /mthu stobs mnga' bdag phyag na bsnams/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ lan gsum gsor/ deng phyin chad tha mal gyi spyod pa brtul la/ phyag na rdo rje'i tshul zhugs la tshul bar gyis shig spros pa byed na 'dir yang chu dbang bskur nas mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan dang mchod pa sogs byed do/ /bcu pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs sogs brtul zhugs dang 'dra ba las/ yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog mthing nag /nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub/ bar pa gnyis thal mo rdeb pa/ tha ma gnyis sbrul nag gi sked pa nas 'dzin zhing*/

mgo bo zhal du gsol zhing mjug ma zhabs 'og tu gnon pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis pad+ma tshangs pa brgya byin zla ba nyi ma rnams kyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ= nas baṃ ho 'i bar brtul zhugs kyi skabs bzhin/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /na bza' chos gos sngon po 'di/ /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ khams gsum kun las rgyal bar shog /rgyan dang cha lugs 'bar ba 'di/ /dpa' bo'i bu yis blang bar gyis/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul bzhugs brtan/ /phyi dang nang na yang dag gnas/ oṃ nī lām+ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi he he/ stangs stabs bya zhing rdo rje gsor la/ hūṃ hūṃ zhes lan mang du brjod/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs tshigs bcad snga ma la stag lpags dang gos sngon tshigs bcad phyi ma'i skabs sbrul rgyan dang khro zhal dang phyag mtshan rdor dril sogs gtod/ gzhan med na rdo rje tsam lag tu gtad pas kyang chog khro zhal zer ba 'di khro 'bag gi ming yin/ tsa ka li byed pa nor ro/ / oṃ badz+ri= mi bskyod par gyur pas dbu rgyan/ puṣ+pe= sogs/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na/ sogs kyis bstod/ deng nas khyod rdo rje 'chang chen po'i brtul zhugs la gnas par gyis shig bcu gcig pa ni/ nga ni shākya seng ge ste/ /rgyan cha phyag na rdo rjer byas/ /'di kun nga yis sprul pa ste/ /ma 'jigs 'jigs par ma byed cig /khyod ni 'khor ba'i 'jigs las thar/ /mi bskyod sangs rgyas zhing khams su/ /rgyal ba'i sras su skye bar 'gyur/ /de ltar bdag gis lung bstan to/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ kyai dpal/ dpal phyag na rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /bhur+bhu wa swa/ dkyil 'khor 'di la dbugs dbyung zer/ spyi khyab tu lung bstan zer ba de yin/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs kyi lag len nam lung bstan spyi dang 'dra'o/

/bcu gnyis pa ni/ bu khyod 'khor lo'i dbang bskur bas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid yin/ /phyag na rdo rje mthu stobs can/ /de bzhin gshegs par lung bstan no/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bdud tshogs kun las nges rgyal te/ /grong khyer mchog du zhugs pa yin/ oṃ ni laṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi sid+dha sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ dpal phyag na rdo rje zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag gis ni slob ma'i dbang mchog bstan zin to/ / sdoms ni/ rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur la//phyir mi ldog dang rjes gnang gnyis/ /gsol btab dbang stegs lha skyed dang*/ /byin rlabs ye shes dbang bskur dang*/ /nang gi lha dbang chos 'khor bskor/ /mchod bstod bstan bzhugs bya ba rnams/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur yin/ /mchod dang sems can don byed pa'i/ /rjes gnang rnam pa gnyis su 'dod/ ces pa blo la nges par bya'o/ /dang po gsol gdab ni/ slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ mtshan ma med par 'gro ba'i don/ /gang dag gis ni byed nus pa/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur che/ /dpa' bo chen pos bdag la stsal/ / lan gsum/gnyis pa dbang stegs ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa/ de'i steng thad du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang bla bre/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan/ mtha' skor du mchod pa'i yo byad dpag tu med pa dang bcas par gyur/ gsum pa lhar bskyed pa ni/ gdan de'i steng du rang nyid gnas te/ oṃ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas rdo rje= yum rdo rje snye ma dkar mo gri gug dang = bzhi pa byin rlabs dang lnga pa ye shes ni/

dpral bar= sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ drug pa dbang bskur ni/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar gyur/ ji ltar bltams pa= nas/ shri ye hūṃ/ de ltar dbang bskur bas= rdo rje 'chang chen por gyur pas dbu brgyan/ de dag ni chu dbang la 'don pa spo rgyu yin/ bdun pa nang gi lha dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gyen du langs pa/ de'i lte bar dpal 'khor lo chen po lha bco brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ nī lāṃ= nas hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan dgu'am bco brgyad bzlas/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje de'i lte bar gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /tad+ya thā/ bho bho= nas ṣ+ya ti hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje yum lha mo mdzes ldan mas 'khyud pa/ thugs ka nas byung rang gi snying ga'i nang gi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ pa ra kra ma ya phaṭa= nas na sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams thugs ka nas spros/ rang gi snying ga'i nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi so so'i gdan la 'khod par gyur/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi zhal phyag sogs mngon rtogs bzhin brjod na legs/ spros pa la dga' na 'dir yang gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams byed de legs pa'ang yin la/ bsdu na lha bkod pa tsam gyis chog go /brgyad pa chos 'khor bskor du bzhug pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bha ga raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+ṭe aḥ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/

/tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ / yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dṛ med kun du gang bar gyis/ zhes brjod/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs/ 'khor lo dung dril bu po ti rnams gtod/ bdag nyid khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur pa la mchod pa sna tshogs kyis mchod par gyur/ dgu pa mchod bstod ni/ ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta 'i bar mchod pa dgu tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar phul/ stobs po che la drag shul che/ /rig sngags rgyal po dge ba po/ /gdul dka' ma lus 'dul mdzad pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod/ bcu pa brtan bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ de dag gi phyir mi ldog gi dbang ngo*/ / rjes gnang gnyis kyi mchod pa'i rjes gnang ni/ de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ mi bya ba ni gang yang med/ /dpa' bo chen po nga yi bkas/ /'dod pa lnga la spyod par gyis/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i rjes gnang ni/ deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis/ /lus dang srog la mi blta bar/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ /'gro ba'i don ni mnyam med kyis/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung chos can/ /sems can sgyu ma'i rang bzhin no/ khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ ces pa'o/ /de nas de kho na nyid brjod pa ni/ gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chog sum cu rtsa bdun no/ / srung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ 'jig rten pa dang theg pa dman pa rnams kyis rtogs par dka' ba'o/ /dur khrod brgyad ni rnam shes brgyad dag pa'o/ /phung po lnga dag pa'i ye shes lnga ni khro bo lnga'o/ /'byung ba lnga dag pa'i tshad med lnga ni yum lnga'o/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dang 'phrin las dag pa'i sgo skyong rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das ni chos nyid mi 'gyur bas sku mdog dang rtsa zhal mthing ka'o/

/g.yas zhal dkar ba ni skyon dang bral ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba ni sems can rjes su 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum ni dus gsum mkhyen pa/ zhabs gnyis kyi bskyang bskum ni rtag pa dang chad pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pa/ phyag drug ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug ste/ sa gsum gyi gdon 'joms pa/ gzung 'dzin spangs ba'i stag lpags/ mi dge ba spangs pa'i gos sngon/ sna tshogs pa'i yon tan ni sku'i rgyan no/ /zhes brjod/ de ltar na phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag /lam bskyed rim sgom pa dang 'phrin las sgrub pa la dbang*/ sa dang po man chad kyi nus pa 'jog sku rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas/ gsang dbang du man+ṭal phul/ slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /gsang ba'i spyod pa thabs ldan pa'i/ /shes rab chen po'i snod 'gyur phyir/ /dbang bskur chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'am/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur stsal du gsol/ zhes 'don pa spos kyang rung*/ lan gsum/ gsang spyod thabs dang ldan pa yi/ /ye shes bdud rtsi dri ma med/ /bdud rtsi chen po'i ro myang phyir/ dbang bskur 'di la khyod spro'am/

tshig gong ma gsum 'dra ba las/ dbang bskur 'di la bdag spro lags/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ/ mig dar bcings/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer ma mchis pa/ yab yum rjes su chags pa snyoms par zhugs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab yum gyi sku la rjes su bzhugs par gyur/ yum gyi pad+ma'i sna rtser pad+ma 'dab lnga'i lte ba la rdo rje mā ma kī/ 'dab ma bzhi la spyan ma dang*/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang*/ gos dkar mo dang*/ sgrol ma rnams bzhugs/ yab kyi rdo rje'i bu gar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar mi bskyod pa/ rtsibs bzhi la rnam snang rin 'byung*/ 'od dpag med/ don yod sgrub pa rnams 'khor bar gyur/ phyi dang nang gi lha mo rnams kyi mkha' ni aḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma aḥs mtshan pa dang*/ dpa' bo rnams kyi gsang ba hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ phyi dbyibs kyi lha yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ gzhir gnas kyi thig le dkar dmar dang*/ sngar spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor bcas thams cad gsang ba'i rigs lnga yab yum la thim/ rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas thabs dang shes rab ro mnyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bde ba'i ngo bor zhu/ de nyid thabs shes kyi mkha' gsang las phyir byung ste/ bdag gi lce la bzhag / dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /dam tshig 'di ni ngo mtshar che/ khams lnga yi ni ros gang ba'i/ /bde ba chen po myang bar gyis/ zhes ched du brjod/ ā ho su kha skal chen po/ / dngos sgrub dam pa rtsal du gsol/ gsang rdzas myangs bar gyur/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems ni bzang po yis/ /de bzhin bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de ltar na byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/

ngag gi dri ma dag /sa bdun pa man chad kyi nus pa bzhag /lam rtsa dang rlung gi rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang*/ gsung rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal pa can du byas so/ / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol gdab dang dri ba dri lan mig dar bcing ba gsang dbang dang 'dra ba las/ shes rab ye shes dbangabaskur stsol/ zhes 'don pa spos kyang rung*/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya ye shes bsgrub pa'i don du gtad par gyur/ lha mo 'di ni khyad par che/ /mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo/ /rnam pa kun tu phyag rgya long*/ /bu yi bla med mchod par gyis/ /des kyang byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /bu yis ci dgar bza' nus sam/ /phyag rgya lnga las byung ba yi/ /rig ma dad pas mchod nus sam/ /bshang gci khu ba rak+ta sogs/ /'di nyid du ni bsten nus sam/ /nga yi gsang ba'i pad+ma ni/ /bde ba myur du skyes pa ste/ khyod kyis rtag tu mchod nus sam/ zhes bris pa la/ ji skad bshad pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ zhes lan btab/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje dang*/ rig ma lha mo mdzes ldan ma'i skur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūṃ gis mtshan zhing / rtse mor phaṭa kyis brgyan pa/ yum gyi mkha' aḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa aḥyig gis mtshan pa/ yab yum snyom par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi mes spyi bo'i haṃ yig bzhu ste/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhir lugs 'byung dang lugs ldog gi dga' ba bzhi mngon du byas par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mig dar bkrol/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag nga dang rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ /mched dang lcam dral la sogs dang*/ khams gsum sems can thams cad la/ /ma mos brnyas par ma byed cig /gzhan yang dam tshig bshad pa rnams/

/rtag tu khyod kyis srung bar gyis/ /deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rmi lam bzhin du sems can gyi/ /don ni bdag nyid kun gyis kyai/ de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag /pho nya'i lam sgom pa la dbang*/ dag pa sa gsum gyi nus pa bzhag thugs rdo rje mngon du 'gyur pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ / dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ dbang bskur gsum po bdag la gnang*/ /de ring ring chen bzhi pa yang*/ /bka' drin gyis ni bdag la skyobs/ lan gsum/ ye shes 'di ni cher phra zhing*/ /rdo rje rnying po mkha' dang mtshungs/ /rdul bral mthar sbyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ sems nyid bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gdod ma nas don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du rang shar ba/ zab mo dang gsal ba gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni bzhi pa'i don gyi de kho na nyid do/ / 'di'i gzhung na dbang bzhi pa zhal shes su mdzad/ bod snga ma rnams kyi yi ge na/ bzhi pa la mig dar bcings 'grol re yang byed par byas mod/ rang lugs la mi dgos so/ / de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /lam phyag rgya chen po bsam mi khyab sgom pa la dbang*/ sa bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i nus pa bzhag /ye shes rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal pa can du byas so/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' rtsal pa/ de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi lan gsum/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te= sogs bya/ dge ba bsngo'o/ /de nas nang gtor rnams nang mchod ltar byin gyis rlabs/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la klu dang = zhes pa nas/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig / ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar nang gtor rgyas par 'bul lo/

/de dag gis ni dngos gzhi'i cho ga las/ bdag 'jug gi rim pa rnams bstan zin to/ /slob ma dbang bskur ba'i bya ba la ni/ rnam pa gnyis te/ nub dang po slob ma sta gon gyi bya ba dang*/ nub phyi ma dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i bya ba dngos so/ dang po ni/ lha sta gon gyi nyin par de nyid yin na tshom bu sogs la rjes ma bsdus na/ yol bas sgrib par 'dod kyang mtha' gcig tu nges pa mi dgos pas ci bder bya/ dkyil 'khor bris zin nas dngos gzhi'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i bya ba dang 'brel ba'i skabs yin na/ yol ba 'thug pos bsgribs te phyogs tsam yang mi mthong bar byed pa gal che/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod/ me tog bkye bsdu bya/ slob dpon gyis/ slob ma rnams sems bskyed gsal 'debs su bcug /chos bshad bya/ slob mas sta gon gyi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ nas/ mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ gyi bar spyi dang mthun pa gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ zhes pa nas/ bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig ces pa'i bar spro ba bskyed pa spyi dang 'dra ba las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*/ sogs tshig rkang drug mi byed par/ dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /rdo rje gsang sngags 'di bsgom pas/ zhes brjod pa'i lugs de mdzad/ dpa' bos byang chub shing drud du/ zhes pa man chad spyi 'gro ltar ro/ de nas sdom pa bzung ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar dgu rnam par dag pa bya ste/ de yang/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la/ /sgo gsum dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ zhes pa nas/ de dag don du sems bskyed do/ / zhes pas mthun mong gi sdom pa bzung*/

sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ zhes pa nas/ mya ngan 'das la 'god/ kyi bar ro/ de nas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ amṛ ta sa sangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ pad nyi la g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing rgyan dang cha byas yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ dri bzang bdud rtsi dang bsres pa'i thig le gnas gsum du reg oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po aḥs mtshan pa/ thugs kar hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim par mos shig de nas mchod pa lnga po rim bzhin phul/ deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par/ /mchod pa kun dang ldan pa yi/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig ces so/ /de nas snying po bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i so shing ster te/ cho ga spyi dang 'dra/ de nas spro ba bskyed pa yang*/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ zhes sogs spyi dang 'dra bar brjod pa las/ go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ 'gro don mnyam med byed par nus/ zhes pa 'jug /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ de la bu yis brtson par gyis/ zhes pa ni khyad par ro/ / de nas dpung skud 'ching ste/ a mṛ ta 'i sngags kyis so de nas ku sha sbyin pa yang spyi dang 'dra/ gzhung 'dir ma bshad kyang*/ khyor chu sbyin pa yang dgos pa mngon te/ byed na so shing gi rjes la'o/ de nas rmi lam brtag cing ngan na srung ba ni/ bu kyai nang par dkyil 'khor mchog /mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol zhig dang/ /rmi lam mthongab gang yin pa/

/de kun nga la legs par smos/ zhes brjod cing don bshad pa yang spyi dang 'dra'o/ slob ma sta gon mdo tsam bstan zin to/ /dngos gzhi slob ma dbang bskur ni/ bdag 'jug grol ba na/ slar yang gong bzhin bden stobs brjod nas/ bdag 'jug ji ltar byas pa bzhin slob ma la bskur ba yin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rags rim rnams gong bdag 'jug gi skabs su brjod zin la/ gzhan ni lag len byed pa'i rim pa la bltas pas shes par 'gyur gyi yi ges ci zhig bya/ deng sang 'di na chen rlom 'ga' zhig gzhan la 'gran pa'i phyir dang*/ chos rgyun rnam dag la gnod pa skyel ba'i phyir/ dpe sgrogs kyi dbang bskur 'dra byed de/ sangs rgyas dang thams cad mkhyen par khas len bzhin du/ dbang bskur lugs lag len 'ol ci tsam yang mi shes par yu ba med pa'i gzhug sdum shes ldan khrel ba'i rgyu mang po snang ba/ de dag ni dang por bla ma la ma thob/ bar du lag len ma mthong*/ mthar dpe cha bltas pas go la re byas kyang khong ma khrol ba'i skyon yin/ gzhan la 'dran pa'i phyir du cho ga 'dra byed 'dod nas/ brgyus pa dang khungs gang yang mi 'tshol bar gnas gzhi gog po re nas blun po dam mnyam sdom shor re bos te/ gsang sngags kyi phyag len yar 'bul gyin yod do/ / zer ba mthong ste/ gar 'chams 'dra dang mgur dbyangs yin zer nas bod skad rgyag /mi nag mgo skor 'dra byed/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rmangs nas zhig /gsang sngags kyi srog rtsa bcad/ rgyal khams phur bar byed pa yin pa/ de ltar ma go bar shes ldan yin du re ba'i dge bshes dang*/ sde dpon dag de'i rjes la rgyug pa dag snang ba ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pas thab tu gzhug par bya rgyu yin no// des na gsang sngags kyi chos de rgyud gzhung tshad ldan las bshad pa zhig dgos/ brgyud pa ma chad pa zhig dgos/ lag len ma 'tshol ba zhig dgos/ bla ma'i 'og tu slob ma 'dzul ba zhig dgos/

shes rab dang rig pa yod rlom gyi bla chos byas pas mi 'ong*/ shes rab kyi nyi ma shar ba zhig gis kyang nan tan zhib tig byas pa zhig dgos pa yin/ po ti bltas pa gcig pus kyang mi 'ong*/ nyams myong yin rdzu dang*/ khog nas brdol ba yin lo ba'i zol sbyor dang*/ zhal mthong yin zer ba dang*/ bla ma ma bsten par skye ba dran pa yin/ pha mes kyi chos yin zer ba sogs kyis grul mi btub dus deng sang bla ma'i zhal gyi man ngag gis legs par brgyan pa/ sel med cing byin rlabs dang ldan pa zhig dgos so/ /rjes kyi cho ga ni/ mchod pa gsar ba bshams/ snying pa kha gso/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i mchod pa'i skabs bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ 'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje can/ / dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la/ gzung 'dzin dri mas ma gos par/ / mnyes phyir sku gsung thugs la 'bul/ oṃ nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ añtsa ma naṃ/ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes chu gsum tshig gcig gis 'bul/ / gzhan me tog dam pa 'di dag ni/ zhes sogs rol mo'i bar du gong bzhin/ thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba yi/ zhes pa nas/ las kun sgrub la bstod/ spyi dang mthun par dngos sgrub zhu/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya mang du bzla/ ma 'byor ba dang = sogs/ lhag pa dang ni = sogs/ gtso bo nus pa= sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor yin na brtan bzhugs spyi dang mthun/ rdul tshon gyi cho ga zhag sbrel byed pa'i snga ma rnams la'ang gshegs gsol ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes brjod/ rdul tshon gshegs gsol byed na sngon du tho phyin rten gsum yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs byas/ de rjes rdul tshon gshegs gsol dang*/ rdul tshon chu bor sbyan 'dren dang bum pa bsdu ba dang*/ thig chas bsdu ba gnas gsum byin rlabs dang*/ srung ba dang*/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis sogs bya ste spyi dang 'dra'o/

/'khor lo chen po dbang gi che bar grags/ /rgyud sde'i mthar thug rnal 'byor bla med lugs/ /gsang sngags phyi 'gyur tshad ldan dbang bzhi'i srol/ /mkhas mang bye bas bsten 'di ngo mtshar rmad/ /dbang chog bris pa'i dge ba gang*/ /ston ka'i zla ltar dkar ba des/ /'gro ba drug na spyod pa rnams/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces pa gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil chog srid gsum 'dul byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ dza ba ri pa'i dkyil chog gi gzhung yod/ sma ra chen po'i gsal byed dang*/ kun mkhyen saṅgha ba dang*/ lo tsā ba rin rnam ma dang*/ 'dul 'dzin grags rgyal ma sogs dkyil chog snga phyi mang po'ang mthong mod kyi/ thams cad kha skongs than thun ma gtogs don la 'gal ba mi 'jug cing*/ dkyil chog bod ma rnams na mi gsal ba gzhung na yod pa'ang ci rigs snang*/ 'dir ni gzhung dang mthun par snying po'i gnad bsdus te/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bkod pa'o// // dza ya dza ya dza yan+tu/ yang smras pa/ 'di la dkyil chog mang na yang*/ /man ngag lugs dang gzhung gi lugs/ /ma 'dres 'byed pa nyung ba'i phyir/

/'dir ni gsal bar bkod pa yin/ /bar skabs byung ba'i man ngag la/ /gzhung gi don du rlom pa rnams/ /gzhung ni 'khrugs can yin no zhes/ /gzhung don log par 'dzin pa mthong*/ /lo paṇa dngos kyi man ngag kyang*/ /smad par mi bya bzang mod kyi/ /kyai rdor 'brog lugs 'phags skor dang*/ /'phreng ba'i kha bskongs 'dir mi dgos/ /'di ni thun mong man ngag ste/ /ku sa li ba'i lugs yin pas/ /mang po bltas pa'i legs bsdus kyis/ /chos 'di'i lugs su+u mi 'gyur ro/ /mkhas pa'i lugs la mkhas pa dang*/ /ku sa li la rnal 'byor pa'i/ /lugs bzhin legs par shes na ni/ /skyon med yon tan kun ldan 'gyur/ zhes pa'ang tā ra na thas ched du brjod pa'o/ / zhus dag/ maṅgalaṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil chog srid gsum 'dul byed bzhugs/ -PAGE 114--PAGE 115--PAGE 67-
